data.body: **[P2] Preserve registration order for invocation-context initialization.** `createPlugins` constructs every plugin before any `onInvocationStart` hook runs, while both refactored OTel plugins now invoke the configured `ContextExtractor`, read `Span.current()`, and start their invocation span in their constructors. Consequently, an earlier registered plugin that prepares a ThreadLocal propagation context or current span in its start hook no longer affects the OTel plugin, changing trace IDs, parenting, and sampling from the previous ordered-hook behavior. Either interleave each factory with its start hook while publishing safely, or move OTel context/span initialization back into `onInvocationStart` and publish those writes afterward; cover this with a two-plugin ordering test.
